# Q03 quest handlers (verteron, heiron): deviations and generated files

## P6-Q slice 2, lane Q03 (2026-09-29)

The zones a new Daeva goes to after the ascension route: the route's dispatch quests (Q06's 1913-1916, 19070/19071) end in Verteron, and
Heiron follows. Night capacity until 18:00 (owner, 2026-09-29: "Return to night time usage limits until 6pm"); U1/U7 (phase-6 handlers in
their own chunk, spare build slots only, and "a phase-6 lane that turns a phase-5 test or gate red is reverted, not fixed forward"; the
lane brief: a handler that changes what a phase-5 gate sees is held back and listed). The method is slice 1's
(docs/design/p6q-ascension-route.md): questgen's output copied into the tree with no hand edit, the generator fixed where the compile needed
it, the golden-trace harness driving every generated file, the two refused files ported by hand. Committed locally on branch `p6q/q03`
(worktree `D:\aion-server-wt\session`, based on C++ `a72676184`, not pushed) for the integrator, after the review of the same day (section
"Review of 2026-09-29").

### Generated files

The chunk has 78 Java handlers (`game-server/data/handlers/quest/{verteron,heiron}`). **74 are in the tree** under
`game-server/handlers/aion/gameserver/handlers/quest/` and register with `AION_QUEST_HANDLER`: 72 are questgen's output (tier A and B), 2
are hand ports (below). **4 are held back** (section "Held back"): `verteron/_14010TerrainOfTheVerteronFortress`, `_1131UndeliveredArmor`,
`_1146DelicateMandrake`, `_1152OdellaRecipe`.

- `verteron/` (22 of 26, all generated): `_1141BelbuasTreasure`, `_1149MissingPoppy`, `_1156StolenVillageSeal`, `_1157GaphyrksLove`,
  `_1158VillageSealFound`, `_1162AltenosWeddingRing`, `_1163ArachnaAntidote`, `_1169LightningfootTuka`, `_1170HeadlessStoneStatue`,
  `_1183SpiritOfNature`, `_1192VerteronReinforcements`, `_1194ReducingTursinStrength`, `_1197KrallBook`, `_1198TheWritingOnTheWall`,
  `_1218NumonerksDemandNote`, `_1220ASecretDelivery` and the Elyos Verteron campaign `_14011FragmentsInTheSky` .. `_14016AGateAgape`.
- `heiron/` (52 of 52: 50 generated, 2 hand ports): the Heiron campaign `_14050OrdersFromHeironFortress` .. `_14054KrallIngToKralltumagna`,
  the 1527-1693 side quests, `_18600`-`_18602` (Kromede), `_3502NereusNeedsYou` and the Dark Poeta quests `_80217`-`_80220`.

Regenerate (from `cpp/`): `python -m tools.gen.questgen --dry-run --emit <dir outside the repo> --only verteron/<file>.java heiron/<file>.java
...`, then copy `<dir>/aion/gameserver/handlers/quest/{verteron,heiron}/*.cpp` into the tree. `tools/gen/tests/test_questgen_tree.py`
regenerates every bannered tree file and compares the bytes, and `test_questgen_q03.py` pins the chunk's list and the held-back files:
**no hand edit**.

Five of the 72 call `HandlerResult::fromBoolean` (H-06, `HandlerResultInfo.h`, declared since M5d): `_1198`, `_14014`, `_1559`, `_1573`,
`_1670`. Built with no error and no warning under the project flags (`/W4`), in the unity build and file by file
(`-DAION_HANDLER_UNITY=OFF`, the Q03 library alone, then back to ON).

### Held back

The review of 2026-09-29 measured what the chunk changes in `gs.scenario.travel`, the one phase-5 gate that goes to Verteron: its Elyos
Daeva (Travellera: a level-10 Gladiator seeded with 1006 COMPLETE) teleports from Sanctum to Verteron (T1) and flies inside it (T2). A map
arrival runs `CM_LEVEL_READY` (Java `CM_LEVEL_READY.java:88-93`, C++ `CM_LEVEL_READY.cpp:108-113`): `PlayerController.updateNearbyQuests`
(SM_NEARBY_QUESTS: the map's quest ids, i.e. the `addOnQuestStart` registrations of its spawned npcs, `WorldMapInstance.addObject`, each
shown when `QuestService.checkStartConditions(player, id, false, 2, ...)` holds: a grey marker up to two levels below the quest's minimum),
then `QuestEngine.onEnterWorld`. Measured with a packet dump of the gate's client (a temporary, env-gated write in `TravelScenarioTest.cpp`'s
`disconnect`, restored byte for byte, sha256 checked, and rebuilt; never committed), each run passing:

| Build | T1's Verteron arrival | Quest packets of the whole run |
|---|---|---|
| the lane's 78 handlers | SM_NEARBY_QUESTS holds **1131, 1146, 1152** (grey) besides the XML quests; then **SM_QUEST_ACTION ADD 14010** (START) and a second SM_NEARBY_QUESTS | 11 SM_NEARBY_QUESTS, 7 SM_QUEST_ACTION; `player_quests` gets 14010 START |
| the 74 in the tree | SM_NEARBY_QUESTS = 1133-1140, 1145, 1147, 1161, 1187, 1222, 1223 (the XML quests only), no quest action | 10 SM_NEARBY_QUESTS, 6 SM_QUEST_ACTION; no quest id of the chunk in any quest or dialog packet; every other packet count equal |

- **14010** (Terrain of the Verteron Fortress, the Elyos Verteron campaign's first mission): `onEnterWorldEvent` starts it for any Elyos of
  level 10+ entering Verteron without it (`_14010TerrainOfTheVerteronFortress.java:52-57`). Java-faithful, but traffic the travel gate did not
  have.
- **1131** (min level 11), **1146** and **1152** (min level 12): their start npcs (203097, 203123, 203132) stand in Verteron, so the arrival's
  SM_NEARBY_QUESTS gains their grey markers for a level-10 character. No other quest of the chunk passes the check for him (1141 needs 1143;
  the rest start at 14+ or in Heiron at 20+).

The four transliterate (questgen), are at parity, and passed all their golden cases with the files in; they stay out of the tree until the
travel gate's owner (P5-SC / M5f) accepts the Java-faithful Verteron quest traffic (or its Elyos is seeded where these quests do not show).
What that costs until then: the Verteron campaign 14011-14016 cannot start (each chains from 14010 through `defaultOnLevelChangedEvent` /
`defaultOnQuestCompletedEvent`), as slice 1's Poeta missions wait for 1000; and three Verteron side quests are missing. Landing them is the
regenerate command above for the four files plus four table edits: `GoldenHandlers.h` (`AION_GOLDEN_GENERATED_HANDLERS`, `GOLDEN_HELD_BACK`),
`GoldenQ03Handlers.cpp`, `tests/quest_handlers_q03/Q03Handlers.h` (`AION_Q03_HANDLERS`, `Q03_HELD_BACK`) and `test_questgen_q03.py`
(`HELD_BACK`); the knownVacuous rows of 1131, 1152 and 14010 were measured before the accept overlay and are to be measured again then.
The four files are kept as questgen emits them (byte-identical to the pristine output: the regenerate command reproduces them).

`TravelArrivalTest` (tests/quest_handlers_q03/GeneratedHooksTest.cpp) pins it without a server: all 74 handlers registered, the gate's Elyos at
T1's arrival point in Verteron, `QuestEngine.onEnterWorld` starts nothing and no quest of the chunk registered at a Verteron spawn passes
updateNearbyQuests' check. With the four files back in the tree (and the table) both cases fail, naming 14010 and 1131/1146/1152.

### Generator changes (tools/gen/questgen)

The first compile of the 76 files gave three errors and one warning; each is fixed in the generator, small and additive:

| Change | Where | Why (the compile) | Emitted files changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A pointer dereferenced for a `T&` parameter (`*player->getWorldMapInstance()` for `spawnForFiveMinutes`' `WorldMapInstance&`) includes T's header | `emit.py` `convert` (`self.need(e.ct.name)`) | C2027 in `_14016AGateAgape`, `_1636AFluteForTheFixing`: `Ptr<T>::operator*` needs the complete T, which the handler got only when another statement named T | 25: `WorldMapInstance.h` in 15, `WorldPosition.h` in 10 |
| A returned `Ref<T>` includes T's header; `api.OWNING_RETURN_HEADERS` names the header of a T whose own header questgen does not scan (`Effect`) | `emit.py` `ret_type`, `api.py` | C2027 in `_18602NightmareinShiningArmor`: the discarded `Ref<Effect>` of `SkillEngine.applyEffectDirectly` is destroyed in the handler (`~Ref`) | 4 (`Effect.h`) |
| An empty Java switch (`switch (targetId) { }`, `_1194ReducingTursinStrength.java:52-53`) becomes its selector evaluated: `static_cast<void>(targetId); // Java: an empty switch`, its comments kept | `emit.py` `switch` | C4060 (a switch without a label; `default: break;` gives C4065) | 1 |

Measured by emitting the whole corpus before and after (`--dry-run --emit`, all 1,035 Java handlers, 929 emitted, 106 refused as before):
**30 of the 929 emitted files change**, each by one added `#include` line or (`_1194`) the switch; no other line differs, and no file of
the tree outside this chunk changes (the 30 are 5 of Q03's and 25 of chunks not in the tree yet). tools/parity finds all 929 at parity
after the change (`parity.py tree` over the emitted corpus: 929 compared, 0 mismatched). New tests: `tools/gen/tests/test_questgen_q03.py`
(9: the chunk's files in the tree but the held-back ones, the held-back ones transliterating and staying out, the 2 refused ones and their
conventions, byte-for-byte regeneration, the three fixes on the chunk's files and on synthetic handlers).

### Hand ports

questgen refuses two files of the chunk, both for anonymous `Runnable`s only (`--verbose`: `anonymous-class`); they are ported statement by
statement in questgen's style (questgen's output for a copy of the Java with the Runnables' bodies inlined, then the tasks written back as
pinned tasks), and both are at parity (`parity.py pair`).

| File | Java | Refused construct | Port |
|---|---|---|---|
| `heiron/_1643TheStarOfHeiron.cpp` | `heiron/_1643TheStarOfHeiron.java` | the Runnable of `:98` (fieldmap `_1643TheStarOfHeiron$1`, storage: task) | `schedule({&star}, [&star] { star.getController().delete_(); }, 40000)`: its one capture, the npc, is the Pin (the `_2136TheLostAxe` idiom) |
| `heiron/_3200PriceOfGoodwill.cpp` | `heiron/_3200PriceOfGoodwill.java` | the Runnables of `:102` and `:134` (`$1`, `$2`); also `WorldMapInstance.getNpc` of `:85`, outside questgen's API table | `schedule({this, &env}, [this, &env] { updateQuestStatus(env); }, 3000)`; `schedule({this, &user, &env, &state}, [this, &user, &env, &state, itemObjId, id] {...}, 3000)` (the handler Immortal, RT-11; the two ints copied); `WorldMapInstance::getNpc` directly (ported, `WorldMapInstance.cpp:202`) |

No engine body was ported and no frozen header changed (no header request). **Neither hand port deviates from Java.** Java behaviour kept as
it is:

- 1643: three dialog arms have no var guard (`_1643TheStarOfHeiron.java:69-82`, `:93-105`), kept and marked `// java-bug kept` (U3, as
  slice 1's `_1006Ascension.cpp:86`): each SETPRO1 at Erato (204630) adds 1 to var 0, takes the disk and spawns another spirit at any START
  var; SET_SUCCEED at Erato sets REWARD at any var (var 0 skips the quest); SETPRO1 at the spirit (204614) adds 1 at any var. Pinned by
  `StarOfHeironTest.EratosAndTheSpiritsArmsHaveNoVarGuardAJavaBugKept`.
- 1643, not bugs: the spirit Erato spawns stays five minutes (`spawnForFiveMinutes`) but is deleted 40 s after its SETPRO1; a relog at var 1
  (spirit spawned, not yet talked to) puts the step back to 0 (`onEnterWorldEvent`), so Erato spawns a new one. 204614's arm has no `break`
  or `return` after its inner switch (the last case), so another action there answers false through `:117`.
- 3200: Haorunerk's bag (700522) answers any dialog action at var 2 (only there) with `true` and an `updateQuestStatus` 3 s later that changes
  nothing (the scroll comes from the bag's quest drop, `quest_data.xml:20170`); `SELECT2_1` at Haorunerk plays movie 431 and answers false;
  the instance, the corpse (`steelRake.getNpc(798333)`) and the npc are dereferenced without a null check, as Java does (a
  `NullPointerException` there, which `QuestEngine.onDialog` catches). The scroll's task takes the item and teleports to Reshanta 3 s after
  the use whatever happens meanwhile (it is not cancelled).

1643's three unguarded dialog arms (Hand ports), marked `// java-bug kept` and pinned; questgen's `KNOWN_JAVA_BUGS` has no row for the
generated files. Paths the oracle writes that Java cannot take are listed in the harness, not changed: the `canRepeat` false paths of 1687
and 80217-80220, whose templates repeat without limit (`max_repeat_count="255"`).

### Gate impact

Every handler of the tree registers in every gate (the registry has no per-profile switch; none of the 74 reads `ENABLE_SIMPLE_2NDCLASS`):
every gate server logs "Loaded 4300 quest handlers" (slice 1's 4,226 + 74), with no "Duplicate handler" warning. What the handlers can do in
the phase-5 gates, from the code and the data (the lane's first analysis looked at the login only and missed the map arrival; the review
corrected it):

- **Map arrivals** (`CM_LEVEL_READY` runs `QuestEngine.onEnterWorld` and `updateNearbyQuests` on every one): the gates' characters are in
  Poeta, Ishalgen, Sanctum, Pandaemonium, Altgard, Verteron (travel T1/T2) and the ascension instances. The chunk's start npcs stand in
  Verteron and Heiron, and one (1553's 203786, min level 43) in Sanctum: only Verteron's reach a gate's character (level 10) at all, which is
  what held 1131, 1146 and 1152 back. The enter-world hooks: 14010 (held back); 14050 starts only in Heiron (no gate goes there); 1643, 1693,
  14016 and 18602 act only on a QuestState of their own quest.
- **Level changes and completed quests** (the ascension gate levels 9 -> 10 and completes 1006/1007, 2008/2009): 14011-14016 and 14051-14054
  (`defaultOnLevelChangedEvent`, `defaultOnQuestCompletedEvent`) need 14010 / 14050 (or the campaign's earlier missions) COMPLETE, and 14050's
  level-change hook is its enter-world hook (Heiron). 1535's `onLevelChangedEvent` is dead code: its `register()` never calls
  `registerOnLevelChanged` (`QuestEngine.java:230-244` calls only registered quests), in Java and in C++.
- **Npcs the gates talk to, kill or approach**: the only overlap is 3502's talk registration on Jucleas (203752), whom the ascension gate's
  ceremony (1007) talks to: without a 3502 QuestState its `onDialogEvent` answers false with no effect (`_3502NereusNeedsYou.java:44-69`), so
  1007's dialog is unchanged. The at-distance registrations (1661's 206045-206047, 1670's 212281-212283) name Heiron npcs only;
  `QuestEngine.onAtDistance` returns early for an unregistered npc id (`QuestEngine.cpp:655-663`), so the npc-sees-player path of m5a_geo's
  census analysis (p6q-ascension-route.md §7) is untouched. The Poeta object 730191 (1537, 1540) and the other talk npcs of the chunk are
  talked to by no gate.
- **Engine-wide hooks** (`registerOnDie`, `registerOnLogOut`, `registerOnQuestTimerEnd`, reach/lost target): each hook acts only on its
  quest's own QuestState.

Measured: the travel gate's packet dump above (after the hold-back no quest id of the chunk in any quest or dialog packet, and every other
packet count equal to the run with the lane's 78). The gate run of the committed tree is under "Verification".

No landed Q03 quest is blocked by a held-back handler of slice 1 (Left).

together; since the review the switch takes a comma-separated list, so an overlay can be shown to be what kills a mutant), sources saved
